item.title: I finally get to title a post "Linux Tarballs"
item.description: 4-20 Blaze it 303 Cush is lit rn fam. Except, there’s a bunch of chegs or something here, and they’re being loud and annoying. Otherwise, today was a good day - the DH was good, Hackers was fun, OS was fun, and I won at pocket tanks. Oh, and I got i3 working! OK, seriously, there are 4 chegs here sitting in opposite corners of the lab screaming to each other.
